edition.authority: Sacred Congregation of Rites; Pope John XXIII
edition.notes: The promulgating Acta witness. Pars prima, Rubricae generales, runs nn. 1-137 on printed pp. 597-621; pars secunda, Rubricae generales Breviarii Romani, nn. 138-268 on pp. 622-643; pars tertia, Rubricae generales Missalis Romani, nn. 269-530, ends on printed p. 685; the promulgated Calendarium Breviarii et Missalis Romani begins on p. 686 and is followed by the tables of occurrence and concurrence and their Notanda, ending on p. 705; the Variationes in Breviario et Missali Romano and in Martyrologio Romano follow on pp. 706-740. At n. 18 d this witness prints the arithmetically impossible ordinal 'XVII' where the 1962 Missale Romanum prints 'XXVII'; the volume's Corrigenda notice does not reach the page.
edition.title: Rubricae Breviarii et Missalis Romani

work.author: Catholic Church
work.description: The 1960 code of rubrics for the Roman Breviary and Missal, approved by John XXIII on 25 July 1960 and promulgated by the Sacred Congregation of Rites on 26 July 1960. It is arranged in three parts: Rubricae generales (nn. 1-137), Rubricae generales Breviarii Romani (nn. 138-268), and Rubricae generales Missalis Romani (nn. 269-530). Part one governs the liturgical day, its four classes, Sundays, ferias, vigils, feasts and calendars, octaves, seasons, the Litanies, the table of precedence, occurrence, concurrence, commemorations, and colours.
work.title: Rubricae Breviarii et Missalis Romani
